scope: Bounded commissioning validation of top-trader account and global-account ratio source semantics only. This does not resolve taker semantics, create paper fills, change the frozen model/strategy, rewrite source values, or promote readiness gates.

semantic_basis.formula: Long/Short Ratio (Accounts) = Long Account % / Short Account %
semantic_basis.method: For each row, intersect the true long-account-share interval implied by the connector's rounded longAccount and by 1-shortAccount, then transform the interval monotonically through p/(1-p). The archive higher-precision ratio must fall inside that evidence-derived interval. This is not an ad-hoc tolerance and raw values are not changed.
semantic_basis.endpoint_reported_ratio_check: The connector longShortRatio must equal the ratio of its published longAccount/shortAccount components rounded to the connector's published ratio precision.

interpretation: The earlier top_accounts/global_accounts exact-ratio mismatches are fully compatible with the connector's finite-precision published account-share components under the documented account-ratio formula across all 283 rows per family. They are therefore resolved as a precision representation contract, not by mutating raw data or widening an arbitrary error tolerance.
